root_causes: The order worker thread got stuck in a wait state and stopped consuming the queue. The deeper reason it stalled is unknown.
evidence: Queue depth grew from 13 to 35 while processed stayed at 14.
The last worker log line was DEBUG 'worker entered wait state'.
Config was healthy (internal://payments-v1, worker_count 1), and recent_changes showed nothing near the incident start.
args.impact: At peak, 35 orders were queued and unprocessed (queued_orders total_sar 25603.33). No orders were dropped, none were processed without payment, and the ledger had no integrity failures. After the restart all 77 orders were processed and paid.
recommended_actions: Find out why the worker entered the wait state and never resumed.

args.summary: The worker stalled in a wait state, so the queue backed up to 35 orders while /health stayed green. I restarted the worker. The backlog drained, all 77 orders are paid, and check_invariants is green. The reason the worker stalled is still unknown.
